mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.comment.selectListCommentByTaskId */ c.comment_id AS commentId, c.task_id AS taskId, c.user_id AS userId, c.message AS message, c.created_at AS createdAt, u.user_name AS userName, u.profile_image_url AS userImage FROM comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{startOffset}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.comment.selectComment */ COMMENT_ID as commentId, TASK_ID as taskId, USER_ID as userId, MESSAGE as message, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.comment.selectListComment */ COMMENT_ID as commentId, TASK_ID as taskId, USER_ID as userId, MESSAGE as message, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM COMMENT WHERE 1=1
) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.comment.selectListCountComment */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM COMMENT WHERE 1=1
